name: Tomato Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put one quart can of tomatoes over the fire in a stewpan
Add one slice of onion and two cloves, a little pepper and salt
Remove from the fire and strain it through a sieve
Melt one ounce of butter in another pan, and as it melts, sprinkle in one tablespoonful of flour
Stir it until it browns and froths a little
Mix the tomato pulp with it, and it is ready for the table

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put one quart can of tomatoes over the fire in a stewpan
2. Add one slice of onion and two cloves, a little pepper and salt
3. Boil about twenty minutes
4. Remove from the fire and strain it through a sieve
5. Melt one ounce of butter in another pan, and as it melts, sprinkle in one tablespoonful of flour
6. Stir it until it browns and froths a little
7. Mix the tomato pulp with it, and it is ready for the table
